svg.aria-label: A glowing globe in the middle, circled by music notes, a film reel, a T-shirt, a coffee cup, a book and a roof. On the right, a sample essay is colour-coded into introduction, body paragraphs and conclusion, with a magnifying glass and a highlighter.
svg.title: Week 5 Day 4: Negotiate, check, rebuild
